title: TUBOLs
description: An immersive experience of a dungeon rpg game for you and your friends
body:
Embark on epic journeys filled with quests, dungeons, and character growth. Choose a path that fits your playstyle—warrior, scholar, ranger, artisan, or something in between—and develop your skills through use, training, and meaningful choices. NPCs remember your actions, offer branching quests, and form relationships that can evolve into friendships, rivalries, or partnerships.

Between adventures, slow down and enjoy the rhythm of daily life. Tend farms that change with the seasons, cook meals that provide long-term buffs, decorate and upgrade your home, and participate in village events like festivals, markets, and celebrations. Time, weather, and mood all influence the world around you, making each day feel alive and personal.

Whether you’re delving into ancient ruins or sharing a quiet evening by the hearth, Hearth & Heroes invites you to live your story—one quest, one day, and one moment at a time.
